subject: Ops + Eng workshop — scheduling, calendar handoff, and attendee roster (HealthSync)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@healthsync.com>, Michael Tran <michael.tran@healthsync.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + two proposed slots for Ops + Eng workshop

Hi Sarah / Michael —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. Quick recap from our side and a proposal for next steps so we can align engineers and procurement: 

- Goal: 60–75 min Ops + Eng workshop to map integration points (API endpoints, SSO), data retention expectations, and performance targets so we can size a Dedicated plan or propose Hosted with caching configuration.
- Attendees we think should be there: your platform lead, your procurement rep (if available), our solutions engineer (Monica) and AE (Ben).

I have two options that work for our team (all times PT):
  * Tue Mar 21, 10:00–11:15
  * Thu Mar 23, 13:00–14:15

Attached is a short proposed agenda (proposed-agenda.pdf). Can you confirm which slot you prefer and who from HealthSync will join (names + roles)? Also let us know if procurement should join this workshop or if you prefer a separate procurement touchpoint.

If either slot works I can send the calendar invite with a Meet link and starter agenda.

Cheers,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

---
Attachment: proposed-agenda.pdf (1 page; outline of topics)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah@healthsync.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Tran <michael.tran@healthsync.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + two proposed slots for Ops + Eng workshop

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the recap and the agenda — that looks right to me. We prefer the Tue Mar 21 slot (10:00 PT).

Attendees from our side so far:
- Sarah Lee (Platform Lead)
- Michael Tran (SRE / Integration)
- Carla Nguyen (Engineering Manager) — will confirm by EOD

Please include procurement: procure@healthsync.com (they want to be aware of retention / SLA items). We can decide if procurement needs to attend the full session or just a 15-min procurement sync after the technical portion.

Two small asks for the workshop:
1) If you can include a short section on performance targets / quantization tradeoffs.
2) Could you share any sandbox credentials or demo environment notes ahead of time? That will help our SREs prepare.

Michael and I are copied. Looking forward to the invite.

Best,
Sarah

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + two proposed slots for Ops + Eng workshop

Perfect — thanks, Sarah. Confirming Tue Mar 21, 10:00–11:15 PT. I just created a calendar invite and attached the .ics; Meet link included below.

Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
Calendar attachment: redwood_healthsync_ops_workshop.ics

Planned attendee roster:
- HealthSync: Sarah Lee (Platform Lead), Michael Tran (SRE), Carla Nguyen (Engineering Manager - tentative), procurement@healthsync.com
- Redwood: Monica Patel (Solutions Engineer - lead for technical walkthrough), Ben Carter (AE - commercial/next steps), Vivek Kulkarni (manager / escalation)

Monica will run the technical portion (30–40 min): infra, API auth, SSO, KV caching/latency knobs and expected throughput. Ben will cover high-level pricing model and next steps (10 min). We'll hold 15 min at the end for open questions and procurement items.

Monica — can you please attach a short pre-read (API spec or sandbox notes) when you send the invite?

If procurement prefers not to join the full session we can schedule a 15-min procurement-only call after the tech portion; just let us know.

Thanks,
Vivek

Subject: Updated invite + agenda v2 — Ops + Eng workshop (Mar 21)

Hi all —

I've sent an updated calendar invite for Tue Mar 21, 10:00–11:15 PT (should show up as from "Redwood Inference — Solutions") and attached an expanded agenda (redwood-agenda-v2.pdf). Short notes:

Agenda highlights (v2):
- 10:00–10:05: Intros and objectives
- 10:05–10:25: High level integration pattern + expected flows (Monica)
- 10:25–10:45: Performance and capacity: latency SLOs, batching, quantization options (Monica)
- 10:45–10:55: Deployment options: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (Vivek)
- 10:55–11:05: Commercial overview & next steps (Ben)
- 11:05–11:15: Open Q&A & procurement items (all)

Pre-reads I attached to the calendar link: API quickstart, sandbox endpoints, and a brief note on data retention defaults. If you need service account credentials for the sandbox before the call, reply and I'll provision a short-lived token.

See you Tuesday — joining details are in the invite (Google Meet).

Thanks,
Monica

Two quick items:
- Procurement would appreciate a short one-pager on data retention and access controls ahead of the meeting. If you have a template or SOC2 summary, please attach to the calendar.
- Michael also asked if you can add the API swagger link to the invite. Here's the drive link we used for past integrations: https://drive.healthsync.com/shared/integrations/api-swagger (feel free to upload any Redwood pre-reads there).

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Sarah
